desc:
🐀 Welcome to Steal To Cook!

Sneak into a restaurant, steal ingredients, and cook with your crew. Take control of the waiter, serve the customers, and escape before your cover is blown! 🍳

🥷 Sneak past the chefs and collect ingredients
👥 Team up with up to 3 friends
🍽️ Cook dishes at your own kitchen station
🎩 Climb into the waiter’s hat and run the dining room
👀 Keep customers happy and suspicion low
🪙 Earn coins and unlock classes and accessories
🔥 Unlock different maps and gamemodes!
🚨 Whatever you do… DON’T GET CAUGHT!
Can your crew survive the shift?

🚨NEW CODES 🚨
"RELEASE" - 100 Coins
"SNEAKY" - 50 Coins + 1 Lucky Spin

⭐ Favorite the game and 👍 Like for future updates!

⚠️ The game is still in development—expect new recipes, restaurants, and more!
